usageCacheFailed: Could not access the usage cache. Please retry.
costSubtitle: Convert 7 / 30 days of account usage into API costs for a reference model.
costLoadFailed: Could not load prices. Retry to update; existing simulations retain previous prices.
costRefreshFailed: Could not fetch or parse current prices. Using prices from the date below.
costCacheWriteFailed: Current prices are used for this simulation but could not be saved locally.
costAssumptionsHint: Account activity provides daily totals without model, input/output, or cache breakdowns. Choose a reference model and task preset, then adjust the ratios. These amounts are simulations, not actual bills.
costChooseModelHint: Choose a reference model to estimate USD costs for both cache scenarios.
costCacheRatioHint: Cache hit rate = cached read tokens ÷ all input tokens. Caching only reduces input costs. Output, including reasoning, uses the output rate; reasoning is not added again.
costPresetDisclaimer: Presets are neither official averages nor measurements of this account. Cache hits depend on reusing the same context, and input shares vary by task.
costPresetCodingHint: For repeated code reading and tool calls that reuse long histories, start at 90% cached and compare 80% / 95%. An official multi-turn agent example exceeded 90%, but this is not guaranteed for every task.
costPresetGeneralHint: For mixed Q&A, writing, and analysis, start at 50% cached and compare 30% / 70%. These are comparison scenarios, not measured averages.
costPresetFreshHint: For a first request or little context reuse, start at 0% cached. Single-turn tasks can still hit the cache when they reuse long instructions or reference material.
costPresetCustomHint: Using custom ratios. Lower the cache rate when context changes or reuse is limited; lower the input share when outputs are longer.
costOutputShare: Output accounts for {share}% of this estimate; changing the cache rate does not reduce output costs.
costStaleUsage: Some accounts failed to refresh. Their last successful usage data is retained for this simulation.
costNoCacheRate: No cached read price is published for this model, so scenarios with cached input are unavailable. Set the cache hit rate to 0% to estimate without caching.
costNoQuotaUsage: No daily account usage is available. Click “Refresh account usage” to try again; missing data is not priced as zero.
costPartialAccounts: Only accounts with daily usage are included. These amounts are partial account subtotals.
costDisclaimer: Uses daily account usage over 7 / 30 UTC calendar days including today, at current Standard short-context text prices. Not a subscription bill; excludes long-context premiums, Fast, cache writes, tools, taxes and discounts.
costLinkFailed: Could not open the documentation link. Visit the corresponding OpenAI documentation page in your browser.
costScenariosHint: Total tokens × assumed input share = input tokens; the rest are output, including reasoning. Input tokens × cache hit rate = cached read tokens; remaining input uses the regular rate. The three costs add up to the current estimate. The no-cache comparison keeps output fixed. Cached tokens are part of input, and reasoning tokens are part of output; neither is added twice.
costSelectedRates: {model} · USD per million tokens: input {input}, cached input {cached}, output {output}.
costRatesHint: All-account totals count duplicate local profiles for the same subscription once. Simulations do not read local sessions. Calculations stay on this device; only fetching prices accesses the public pricing document.
costStorageUnsupported: Account usage is unavailable with this credential storage mode
costStorageUnsupportedHint: Account usage requires file credential storage. Update it in Codex config first.
costUsageRefreshFailed: Usage refresh failed for {count} accounts. Retry to load their data; missing usage is not priced as zero.
